meta.name: Select by Text (SAM 3.1)
meta.licenseNote: SAM 3.1 (Meta, 2026-03-27) ships under the SAM License: research and commercial use allowed with no thresholds; military, nuclear, espionage and weapons uses banned; the licence travels with any redistribution; Meta may change the terms. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Node names follow ComfyUI's official 'Image Segment (SAM3)' template (utility_image_segment_sam3.json): CheckpointLoaderSimple loads the SAM 3.1 checkpoint (MODEL + CLIP), CLIPTextEncode on that CLIP turns the phrase into conditioning (≤ 32 tokens; comma-separated terms; 'term:N' caps instances), SAM3_Detect returns one mask per instance (individual_masks true) after 2 decoder refinement passes. MaskToImage + SaveImage write one PNG per instance; PhotoCraft reads each as coverage, picks an instance or unions them, and combines with the current selection.
